verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a dedicated rate-limits guide that documents the limits and how they scale. It explicitly covers tokens-per-minute interactions: cached input tokens still count toward TPM, and Batch has its own separate, higher pool of rate limits. missing for 10: evidence of what a 429 response looks like (headers, error body), explicit requests-per-minute and per-tier figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
